title: EDWARD-NMT: Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for Neural Machine Translation
abstract: arXiv:2610.32115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) is a powerful paradigm for scaling Neural Machine Translation (NMT) and managing language heterogeneity. However, practical limitations hinder its deployment on resource-constrained devices: the entire expert pool must remain in memory, and the per-token compute budget is statically fixed during training by rigid top-k routing. We introduce EDWARD-NMT (Elastic Dimensions With Adaptive Routing and Dual-consistency for NMT), a novel MoE encoder-decoder architecture designed for a train once, deploy anywhere paradigm that exposes a family of deployable sub-networks at inference time. EDWARD-NMT integrates three key innovations: (i) Matryoshka-style elastic dimensions to flexibly reduce the memory footprint; (ii) an adaptive sigmoid router with a learned, task-conditioned threshold, allowing each token to dynamically determine its active expert count; and (iii) a dual-consistency objective to maximize the perf

translated_title: EDWARD-NMT：面向神经机器翻译的弹性维度、自适应路由与双一致性方法
translated_abstract: 稀疏混合专家模型（Sparse Mixture-of-Experts, MoE）是扩展神经机器翻译（NMT）并管理语言异质性的强大范式。然而，实际的局限性阻碍了其在资源受限设备上的部署：整个专家池必须保留在内存中，且每个 token 的计算预算在训练期间被僵化的 top-k 路由静态固定。我们提出了 EDWARD-NMT（面向 NMT 的弹性维度、自适应路由与双一致性），这是一种新颖的 MoE 编码器-解码器架构，专为“一次训练、随处部署”的范式而设计，可在推理时提供一族可部署的子网络。EDWARD-NMT 融合了三项关键创新：（i）套娃式（Matryoshka 风格）弹性维度，可灵活降低内存占用；（ii）具有可学习的、任务条件化阈值的自适应 sigmoid 路由器，使每个 token 能够动态决定其激活的专家数量；（iii）双一致性目标函数，以最大化性能……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: EDWARD-NMT 提出了一种结合套娃式弹性维度、带可学习阈值的自适应 sigmoid 路由器以及双一致性目标的新型 MoE 架构，实现“一次训练、随处部署”，使神经机器翻译模型能够在资源受限设备上灵活部署。
en_tdlr: EDWARD-NMT introduces a novel MoE architecture that combines Matryoshka-style elastic dimensions, an adaptive sigmoid router with a learned task-conditioned threshold, and a dual-consistency objective, enabling a "train once, deploy anywhere" paradigm for deploying NMT models on resource-constrained devices.
